TIME
Good day to everyone.
I am writing the following as I believe it has been laid upon my heart.
Our Understanding of Time
Along our human timeline, things happen in a particular order.
One second follows another, one day follows the previous day, and so the years pass by.
We can only grow older. We cannot become younger.
Our thoughts are also usually focused on what lies ahead. When dealing with other people, our thinking often follows a particular sequence.
First, we consider how something affects me. Then we ask ourselves whether it works for me. Finally, we may even try to arrange things in such a way that we get what we want.
We easily become unhappy when things do not go according to our wishes. We do not like it when circumstances unfold in ways that do not please us.
Sometimes we go even further. We are quick to write people off when they do not think the way we do or when their actions make us unhappy.
When we look at our own behaviour, perhaps we should ask ourselves a few questions:
Are we too quick to judge? Do we too easily place ourselves above others?
We often make ourselves the first priority in our thinking. We adopt an attitude of, “I know what I want.”
As a result, when we deal with others, we tend to measure their actions and needs against our own desires, expectations and understanding.
What Does the Word of God Teach Us?
When we consider the Word of God, we are confronted with some serious truths that deserve our attention.
Consider what the Bible says in the following verse:
“He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that obeyeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.”
John 3:36 (KJV)
The verse makes an important distinction. It speaks not only of believing in the Son, but also of obeying Him.
There are millions of Christians around the world who believe in Jesus. It is easy for us to focus on the part about believing and stop there.
But we must also consider what the Word says about the difference between believing and living out our faith.
“Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble. But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?”
James 2:19–20 (KJV)
These verses challenge us to look beyond what we believe and examine how we live.
What Spirit Do We Reveal to Others?
As we move through our lives, second by second, we continually encounter other people.
How do we treat them?
What spirit do we reveal through our words, our attitudes and our actions?
Do others experience selfishness when they deal with us, or do they experience love?
Do they experience peace, or do they feel rejected?
What spirit are we walking in?
And, perhaps most importantly, how do we walk when things do not go according to our wishes?
It is often in these moments that the true condition of our hearts becomes evident. When everything goes our way, it may be easy to show patience and kindness. But when our plans are disrupted, our expectations are challenged or someone disagrees with us, what comes out of us then?
Do our actions reflect the character of Jesus, or do they reflect our own desires?
Making the Most of Our Time
The Apostle Paul encourages us to make the most of our time:
“Redeeming the time, because the days are evil. Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.”
Ephesians 5:16–17 (KJV)
Notice where the emphasis falls: we are not merely to know the will of the Lord, but to understand it.
Understanding goes beyond simply knowing what something says. When we truly understand, it begins to make sense to us. We recognise the wisdom behind it, and it becomes a guiding principle for how we live and respond to others.
God’s will should not remain information in our minds. It should influence our decisions, our attitudes and the way we treat the people He places in our lives.
In Luke 17:21, Jesus speaks of the kingdom of God in a way that draws attention to its presence among or within us, depending on the translation.
If God’s kingdom is to find expression in our lives, should it not also influence the way we think, the way we respond and the way we treat one another?
When our thinking is shaped by God’s will rather than our own desires, we begin to respond with greater wisdom, patience, love and understanding.
The Word guides us with these words:
“Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.”
Colossians 3:2 (KJV)
Perhaps this is where we need to examine ourselves. Are our thoughts and priorities centred mainly on what we want from this life, or are we allowing the things of God to shape our hearts and our conduct?
We cannot stop time from passing, nor can we return to yesterday. But we can choose how we use the time we have been given and what spirit we reveal to those around us.
May we use our time wisely, seek to understand the will of the Lord, and allow His Word to transform the way we think and live.
Rich blessings to each and every one of you, and may the love of Jesus grow ever greater in each of us.
Amen.

# Flova 订阅与积分

## 先区分问题需要什么依据

套餐规则可以解释一般情况。某个账号的余额、订单是否支付、某次扣费或退款是否完成，需要当前账号、订单或任务记录。
本篇末尾附有共享的产品规则，涵盖会员模型权益、积分到期与购买资格、普通文字聊天扣费及反馈和补偿范围。
实时余额和模型报价可通过 `document_view(target="creation-budget.md")` 查询；生成时的费用预检查决定当次请求能否执行。
余额与报价不能单独证明过去某一笔扣费的原因。

## 套餐、价格与记录的入口

- **套餐和权益：** 在定价页选择个人版或团队版，比较订阅周期和权益。具体价格、优惠及购买资格以结算页面为准。

- **生成价格：**「管理账户」→「价格详情」→「模型价格表」；也可以从「查看用量」进入价格详情。
- **订单与发票：** 符合地区和账号条件时，在「订单发票」查看购买记录、可开票订单和发票状态。

- **没有发票入口：** 核对账号地区及订单资格，不能据此认定支付失败。

支持邮箱及账号入口见账号设置（`/.flova/knowledge/product/account-settings`）。联系支持时提供账号、订单号或任务信息，不提供密码、验证码或 API Key。

 60	
 61	#### Membership Entitlements and Tool Enforcement
 62	
 63	Membership requirements describe product entitlements, but they are not model-selection inputs for the Agent.
 64	
 65	* **Agent Behavior**
 66	    * Treat membership status as informational context for accurate membership-related communication only.
 67	    * Never use membership status to restrict or alter model selection, whether the user specifies a model or expects you to choose one.
 68	    * Choose the model based on the user's intent, desired output, model preference, model knowledge, and tool capabilities.
 69	    * Do not refuse, downgrade, substitute, or skip a generation tool call because of membership status.
 70	    * Call the selected tool; the tool is responsible for permission checks and any required subscription flow.
 71	* **Model Entitlements (informational; enforced by generation tools)**
 72	    * **`Seedance 2.5` / `Seedance 2.0` / `Seedance 2.0 Fast` / `Seedance 2.0 Mini`**: Require membership entitlement. The generation tool enforces this entitlement; the Agent must not use it to pre-filter or replace the selected model.

 75	    * **1080p video**: Requires membership entitlement. While specific resolution support varies by model (see tool details above), membership grants eligibility only; it does not make 1080p the default.
 76	    * **2k / 4k video**: Requires membership entitlement.
 77	    * **720p video**: Generally does not require membership, but membership-only models such as `Seedance 2.5` still require model entitlement, and model-specific supported resolutions such as MiniMax H3 at `768p` remain unchanged.

 79	
 80	Runtime candidates and generation admission remain authoritative for the current account. Do not silently replace an explicit user model or resolution because of membership; report the actual availability decision.
 81

 83	
 84	* Credits belong to the user's account balance and expire according to their own source and validity period.
 85	* Membership expiration does not clear every credit type at once.
 86	* Subscription credits are time-limited credits issued by a subscription plan, normally valid for 30 days.
 87	* Recharge or purchased credits, weekly credits, and reward credits follow their own labeled validity periods.
 88	
 89	Use live account facts when the user asks about their actual balance, expiration date, or a specific balance change. Do not infer a concrete account event from this general policy.
 90	
 91	#### Credit Product Purchase Eligibility
 92	
 93	* Credit-product purchase eligibility depends on the specific product and purchase context.
 94	* In the ordinary personal purchase flow, a user without an eligible membership entitlement cannot directly purchase personal general credit packages.
 95	* Gifted VIP eligibility and team purchases are separate cases; eligible team administrators may purchase general or model-specific credits.
 96	* Do not apply the ordinary personal rule to team contexts. If the product or purchase context is unclear, state that eligibility cannot be confirmed from the available information.
 97

100	* When current Planner context shows `membership_status = non-member`, regular text conversation is charged 5 credits once for the text processing associated with each user message.

102	* Multiple internal text-model calls associated with the same user message are not charged repeatedly.
103	
104	This is a general policy, not evidence explaining a specific charge. For an actual charge, rely only on verified current context or authoritative results.
105

107	
108	Users can submit feedback by rating an Agent message, selecting "Feedback" from the upper-right account menu, or using the official WeChat/Discord links on the homepage. These are general feedback channels and do not guarantee compensation.

110	Unsatisfactory output alone does not establish a system failure or incorrect charge. Never promise, approve, or assert entitlement to compensation, refunds, or credit adjustments. Report compensation as completed only when an authoritative result explicitly confirms it.

description: 订阅、会员模型权益、文字聊天扣费、积分有效期与购买资格、续费取消、退款申请和反馈；含共享产品规则。

# Flova 订阅与积分

## 先区分问题需要什么依据

套餐规则可以解释一般情况。某个账号的余额、订单是否支付、某次扣费或退款是否完成，需要当前账号、订单或任务记录。
本篇末尾附有共享的产品规则，涵盖会员模型权益、积分到期与购买资格、普通文字聊天扣费及反馈和补偿范围。
实时余额和模型报价可通过 `document_view(target="creation-budget.md")` 查询；生成时的费用预检查决定当次请求能否执行。
余额与报价不能单独证明过去某一笔扣费的原因。

## 套餐、价格与记录的入口

- **套餐和权益：** 在定价页选择个人版或团队版，比较订阅周期和权益。具体价格、优惠及购买资格以结算页面为准。
- **积分余额和明细：** 右上角账户入口 →「管理账户」→「积分详情」，查看来源、消耗记录和有效期。
- **生成价格：**「管理账户」→「价格详情」→「模型价格表」；也可以从「查看用量」进入价格详情。
- **订单与发票：** 符合地区和账号条件时，在「订单发票」查看购买记录、可开票订单和发票状态。

套餐通常还涉及可用模型、并发生成数量、授权人像容量、去水印导出、商用授权和画质增强等权益。查看适用条款与当前定价信息，不能从一个套餐名称推断所有权益。
团队成员使用管理员分配的积分，见团队管理（`/.flova/knowledge/product/teams`）。

## 媒体生成消耗和积分来源

图片、视频、语音、音乐和画质增强等操作，按模型、生成类型、分辨率和时长等参数计费，不能用一个固定价格估算所有操作。
提交前参考预计消耗，完成后核对积分明细；普通文字对话的收费规则见本篇末尾。

积分可能来自订阅、额外购买、邀请或活动。订阅和购买资格、会员到期与积分到期的关系见末尾共享规则。
来源文档列出邀请奖励有效期为 7 天、探索使用奖励为 30 天，超创和活动奖励按对应计划规则。
这些是一般规则，实际到期时间应查看每笔积分记录。

来源文档描述的扣除规则同时考虑适用类型和到期时间：距离到期超过 7 天时，优先使用适用的模型专属积分，再使用会员通用积分；距离到期 7 天以内时，优先使用更早到期的积分，同日到期再优先使用模型专属积分。
该一般规则不能代替某次扣费明细；总余额与某一个模型可用的余额也可能不同。

## 升级、续费与取消订阅

升级套餐或将月付改为年付时，核对结算页面列出的旧套餐抵扣、新套餐价格和新周期。来源文档描述旧套餐按已使用积分比例计费、剩余余额抵扣，新周期从升级日起重新计算；具体金额与适用资格以当次结算为准。

订阅通常在计费周期结束时自动续费。需要停止续费时，进入订阅页面的「管理订阅」，选择「取消订阅」。
取消后当前已支付周期的权益通常可继续使用，到期后不再续费；取消订阅不等于立即退款。
促销权益与普通订阅权益需要区分。来源文档描述：在促销期内订阅，优惠权益立即生效；取消订阅会让促销权益同步失效；在同一促销期内重新订阅时，符合规则的剩余优惠权益可以恢复。
具体适用范围、恢复资格和剩余权益以对应活动规则、结算页面及当前账号记录为准，不能将这一有条件的恢复规则理解为任何时间重新订阅都能恢复原优惠，也不能仅凭一般政策认定某个账号已经恢复。

## 退款申请、发票与异常

来源文档列出的退款申请条件是：最近一次付款后 7 天内、未进行生成行为，可以联系支持申请全额退款；文档列出的通常到账时间是 5–10 个工作日。
介绍这些条件时要保留适用前提，具体资格、审核和到账取决于适用条款、订单与支付渠道。仅凭用户描述不能认定符合条件或承诺退款。
系统问题导致生成失败时可能涉及积分退还，但失败原因、扣费和退还状态应由任务及积分记录确认，不能把效果不满意等同于系统故障。

- **积分未到账：** 查看订单支付状态和积分到账记录；仍有差异时，记录订单号和时间联系支持。
- **生成失败后仍显示扣费：** 核对任务状态、扣费和退还明细；保留任务信息联系支持，避免为验证问题重复付费生成。
- **消耗超出预期：** 对比实际模型、规格、预计消耗与对应积分记录。
- **没有发票入口：** 核对账号地区及订单资格，不能据此认定支付失败。

支持邮箱及账号入口见账号设置（`/.flova/knowledge/product/account-settings`）。联系支持时提供账号、订单号或任务信息，不提供密码、验证码或 API Key。
更多官方反馈渠道和补偿说明见下面共享规则。

## 共享产品规则

以下规则由现有产品政策配置提供，与其他使用该配置的入口共用。它们解释一般权益，不代表当前账号已发生某次扣费、退款或补偿。

 60	
 61	#### Membership Entitlements and Tool Enforcement
 62	
 63	Membership requirements describe product entitlements, but they are not model-selection inputs for the Agent.
 64	
 65	* **Agent Behavior**
 66	    * Treat membership status as informational context for accurate membership-related communication only.
 67	    * Never use membership status to restrict or alter model selection, whether the user specifies a model or expects you to choose one.
 68	    * Choose the model based on the user's intent, desired output, model preference, model knowledge, and tool capabilities.
 69	    * Do not refuse, downgrade, substitute, or skip a generation tool call because of membership status.
 70	    * Call the selected tool; the tool is responsible for permission checks and any required subscription flow.
 71	* **Model Entitlements (informational; enforced by generation tools)**
 72	    * **`Seedance 2.5` / `Seedance 2.0` / `Seedance 2.0 Fast` / `Seedance 2.0 Mini`**: Require membership entitlement. The generation tool enforces this entitlement; the Agent must not use it to pre-filter or replace the selected model.

 74	* **Resolution Entitlements (informational; enforced by generation tools)**
 75	    * **1080p video**: Requires membership entitlement. While specific resolution support varies by model (see tool details above), membership grants eligibility only; it does not make 1080p the default.
 76	    * **2k / 4k video**: Requires membership entitlement.
 77	    * **720p video**: Generally does not require membership, but membership-only models such as `Seedance 2.5` still require model entitlement, and model-specific supported resolutions such as MiniMax H3 at `768p` remain unchanged.
 78	    * Do not use the current membership status to preemptively downgrade resolution or skip the tool call; let the generation tool enforce resolution entitlements.
 79	
 80	Runtime candidates and generation admission remain authoritative for the current account. Do not silently replace an explicit user model or resolution because of membership; report the actual availability decision.

 85	* Membership expiration does not clear every credit type at once.
 86	* Subscription credits are time-limited credits issued by a subscription plan, normally valid for 30 days.
 87	* Recharge or purchased credits, weekly credits, and reward credits follow their own labeled validity periods.
 88	
 89	Use live account facts when the user asks about their actual balance, expiration date, or a specific balance change. Do not infer a concrete account event from this general policy.
 90

 92	
 93	* Credit-product purchase eligibility depends on the specific product and purchase context.
 94	* In the ordinary personal purchase flow, a user without an eligible membership entitlement cannot directly purchase personal general credit packages.
 95	* Gifted VIP eligibility and team purchases are separate cases; eligible team administrators may purchase general or model-specific credits.
 96	* Do not apply the ordinary personal rule to team contexts. If the product or purchase context is unclear, state that eligibility cannot be confirmed from the available information.
 97	
 98	#### Regular Text Conversation Credit Usage
 99	
100	* When current Planner context shows `membership_status = non-member`, regular text conversation is charged 5 credits once for the text processing associated with each user message.
101	* When current Planner context shows `membership_status = vip-member`, regular text conversation is not charged.
102	* Multiple internal text-model calls associated with the same user message are not charged repeatedly.
103	
104	This is a general policy, not evidence explaining a specific charge. For an actual charge, rely only on verified current context or authoritative results.
105	
106	#### Official Feedback and Compensation Boundaries
107	
108	Users can submit feedback by rating an Agent message, selecting "Feedback" from the upper-right account menu, or using the official WeChat/Discord links on the homepage. These are general feedback channels and do not guarantee compensation.
109	
110	Unsatisfactory output alone does not establish a system failure or incorrect charge. Never promise, approve, or assert entitlement to compensation, refunds, or credit adjustments. Report compensation as completed only when an authoritative result explicitly confirms it.

I'll check the product guide on credits so I give you accurate information rather than guessing.Good question — and it explains something you may have noticed.

**Where credits come from**

There are a few sources:

- **Subscription plans** — a paid plan issues credits each billing cycle (normally valid ~30 days). Higher tiers also add model access, more concurrent generations, and higher resolutions.
- **Extra credit purchases** — bought on top of a plan. Note that in the ordinary personal flow, buying general credit packages generally requires an eligible membership; the pricing/checkout page is what actually confirms eligibility for your account.
- **Rewards** — invitation rewards (valid ~7 days), exploration-use rewards (~30 days), and campaign/event credits, each on its own expiry schedule.
- **Teams** — team administrators can purchase and assign credits to members.

Each credit type keeps its own expiry, so membership expiring doesn't wipe everything at once. You can see the source, usage history, and expiry of every batch under **account menu → Manage Account → Credit details**.

**About your account**

Your balance currently shows **80 credits, all recorded as reward credits** — so those came from rewards rather than a subscription or purchase.

One thing worth knowing: **every message you send to me in text is charged 5 credits** on a non-member account. That's why the balance read 80 earlier and 75 a moment later — it wasn't the video, it was our conversation. VIP members aren't charged for text chat, which makes longer back-and-forth planning far cheaper.

The finished vertical video still needs about 5 credits for the corrected narration; the 8 slides and music are already paid for and saved. Your reward credits will expire on their own schedule, so it's better to finish the video than to let them lapse on conversation.

Want me to go ahead and generate the corrected narration now, keeping the remaining steps minimal?

name: subscription-credits
description: 订阅、会员模型权益、文字聊天扣费、积分有效期与购买资格、续费取消、退款申请和反馈；含共享产品规则。

# Flova 订阅与积分

## 先区分问题需要什么依据

套餐规则可以解释一般情况。某个账号的余额、订单是否支付、某次扣费或退款是否完成，需要当前账号、订单或任务记录。
本篇末尾附有共享的产品规则，涵盖会员模型权益、积分到期与购买资格、普通文字聊天扣费及反馈和补偿范围。
实时余额和模型报价可通过 `document_view(target="creation-budget.md")` 查询；生成时的费用预检查决定当次请求能否执行。
余额与报价不能单独证明过去某一笔扣费的原因。

## 套餐、价格与记录的入口

- **套餐和权益：** 在定价页选择个人版或团队版，比较订阅周期和权益。具体价格、优惠及购买资格以结算页面为准。
- **积分余额和明细：** 右上角账户入口 →「管理账户」→「积分详情」，查看来源、消耗记录和有效期。
- **生成价格：**「管理账户」→「价格详情」→「模型价格表」；也可以从「查看用量」进入价格详情。
- **订单与发票：** 符合地区和账号条件时，在「订单发票」查看购买记录、可开票订单和发票状态。

套餐通常还涉及可用模型、并发生成数量、授权人像容量、去水印导出、商用授权和画质增强等权益。查看适用条款与当前定价信息，不能从一个套餐名称推断所有权益。
团队成员使用管理员分配的积分，见团队管理（`/.flova/knowledge/product/teams`）。

## 媒体生成消耗和积分来源

图片、视频、语音、音乐和画质增强等操作，按模型、生成类型、分辨率和时长等参数计费，不能用一个固定价格估算所有操作。
提交前参考预计消耗，完成后核对积分明细；普通文字对话的收费规则见本篇末尾。

积分可能来自订阅、额外购买、邀请或活动。订阅和购买资格、会员到期与积分到期的关系见末尾共享规则。
来源文档列出邀请奖励有效期为 7 天、探索使用奖励为 30 天，超创和活动奖励按对应计划规则。
这些是一般规则，实际到期时间应查看每笔积分记录。

来源文档描述的扣除规则同时考虑适用类型和到期时间：距离到期超过 7 天时，优先使用适用的模型专属积分，再使用会员通用积分；距离到期 7 天以内时，优先使用更早到期的积分，同日到期再优先使用模型专属积分。
该一般规则不能代替某次扣费明细；总余额与某一个模型可用的余额也可能不同。

## 升级、续费与取消订阅

升级套餐或将月付改为年付时，核对结算页面列出的旧套餐抵扣、新套餐价格和新周期。来源文档描述旧套餐按已使用积分比例计费、剩余余额抵扣，新周期从升级日起重新计算；具体金额与适用资格以当次结算为准。

订阅通常在计费周期结束时自动续费。需要停止续费时，进入订阅页面的「管理订阅」，选择「取消订阅」。
取消后当前已支付周期的权益通常可继续使用，到期后不再续费；取消订阅不等于立即退款。
促销权益与普通订阅权益需要区分。来源文档描述：在促销期内订阅，优惠权益立即生效；取消订阅会让促销权益同步失效；在同一促销期内重新订阅时，符合规则的剩余优惠权益可以恢复。
具体适用范围、恢复资格和剩余权益以对应活动规则、结算页面及当前账号记录为准，不能将这一有条件的恢复规则理解为任何时间重新订阅都能恢复原优惠，也不能仅凭一般政策认定某个账号已经恢复。

## 退款申请、发票与异常

来源文档列出的退款申请条件是：最近一次付款后 7 天内、未进行生成行为，可以联系支持申请全额退款；文档列出的通常到账时间是 5–10 个工作日。
介绍这些条件时要保留适用前提，具体资格、审核和到账取决于适用条款、订单与支付渠道。仅凭用户描述不能认定符合条件或承诺退款。
系统问题导致生成失败时可能涉及积分退还，但失败原因、扣费和退还状态应由任务及积分记录确认，不能把效果不满意等同于系统故障。

- **积分未到账：** 查看订单支付状态和积分到账记录；仍有差异时，记录订单号和时间联系支持。
- **生成失败后仍显示扣费：** 核对任务状态、扣费和退还明细；保留任务信息联系支持，避免为验证问题重复付费生成。
- **消耗超出预期：** 对比实际模型、规格、预计消耗与对应积分记录。
- **没有发票入口：** 核对账号地区及订单资格，不能据此认定支付失败。

支持邮箱及账号入口见账号设置（`/.flova/knowledge/product/account-settings`）。联系支持时提供账号、订单号或任务信息，不提供密码、验证码或 API Key。
更多官方反馈渠道和补偿说明见下面共享规则。

## 共享产品规则

以下规则由现有产品政策配置提供，与其他使用该配置的入口共用。它们解释一般权益，不代表当前账号已发生某次扣费、退款或补偿。

 32	## 升级、续费与取消订阅
 33	
 34	升级套餐或将月付改为年付时，核对结算页面列出的旧套餐抵扣、新套餐价格和新周期。来源文档描述旧套餐按已使用积分比例计费、剩余余额抵扣，新周期从升级日起重新计算；具体金额与适用资格以当次结算为准。
 35	
 36	订阅通常在计费周期结束时自动续费。需要停止续费时，进入订阅页面的「管理订阅」，选择「取消订阅」。
 37	取消后当前已支付周期的权益通常可继续使用，到期后不再续费；取消订阅不等于立即退款。
 38	促销权益与普通订阅权益需要区分。来源文档描述：在促销期内订阅，优惠权益立即生效；取消订阅会让促销权益同步失效；在同一促销期内重新订阅时，符合规则的剩余优惠权益可以恢复。
 39	具体适用范围、恢复资格和剩余权益以对应活动规则、结算页面及当前账号记录为准，不能将这一有条件的恢复规则理解为任何时间重新订阅都能恢复原优惠，也不能仅凭一般政策认定某个账号已经恢复。
 40	
 41	## 退款申请、发票与异常
 42	
 43	来源文档列出的退款申请条件是：最近一次付款后 7 天内、未进行生成行为，可以联系支持申请全额退款；文档列出的通常到账时间是 5–10 个工作日。
 44	介绍这些条件时要保留适用前提，具体资格、审核和到账取决于适用条款、订单与支付渠道。仅凭用户描述不能认定符合条件或承诺退款。
 45	系统问题导致生成失败时可能涉及积分退还，但失败原因、扣费和退还状态应由任务及积分记录确认，不能把效果不满意等同于系统故障。
 46	
 47	- **积分未到账：** 查看订单支付状态和积分到账记录；仍有差异时，记录订单号和时间联系支持。
 48	- **生成失败后仍显示扣费：** 核对任务状态、扣费和退还明细；保留任务信息联系支持，避免为验证问题重复付费生成。
 49	- **消耗超出预期：** 对比实际模型、规格、预计消耗与对应积分记录。
 50	- **没有发票入口：** 核对账号地区及订单资格，不能据此认定支付失败。
 51	
 52	支持邮箱及账号入口见账号设置（`/.flova/knowledge/product/account-settings`）。联系支持时提供账号、订单号或任务信息，不提供密码、验证码或 API Key。
 53	更多官方反馈渠道和补偿说明见下面共享规则。
 54	
 55	## 共享产品规则
 56	
 57	以下规则由现有产品政策配置提供，与其他使用该配置的入口共用。它们解释一般权益，不代表当前账号已发生某次扣费、退款或补偿。
 58	
 59	### **Knowledge Base 2: Product Access, Credits, and Support**
 60	
 61	#### Membership Entitlements and Tool Enforcement
 62	
 63	Membership requirements describe product entitlements, but they are not model-selection inputs for the Agent.
 64	
 65	* **Agent Behavior**
 66	    * Treat membership status as informational context for accurate membership-related communication only.
 67	    * Never use membership status to restrict or alter model selection, whether the user specifies a model or expects you to choose one.
 68	    * Choose the model based on the user's intent, desired output, model preference, model knowledge, and tool capabilities.
 69	    * Do not refuse, downgrade, substitute, or skip a generation tool call because of membership status.
 70	    * Call the selected tool; the tool is responsible for permission checks and any required subscription flow.
 71	* **Model Entitlements (informational; enforced by generation tools)**
 72	    * **`Seedance 2.5` / `Seedance 2.0` / `Seedance 2.0 Fast` / `Seedance 2.0 Mini`**: Require membership entitlement. The generation tool enforces this entitlement; the Agent must not use it to pre-filter or replace the selected model.
 73	    * **`MiniMax H3`**: `768p` does not require membership; `2k` requires membership entitlement. The generation tool enforces this entitlement; the Agent must not use it to alter model selection.
 74	* **Resolution Entitlements (informational; enforced by generation tools)**
 75	    * **1080p video**: Requires membership entitlement. While specific resolution support varies by model (see tool details above), membership grants eligibility only; it does not make 1080p the default.
 76	    * **2k / 4k video**: Requires membership entitlement.
 77	    * **720p video**: Generally does not require membership, but membership-only models such as `Seedance 2.5` still require model entitlement, and model-specific supported resolutions such as MiniMax H3 at `768p` remain unchanged.
 78	    * Do not use the current membership status to preemptively downgrade resolution or skip the tool call; let the generation tool enforce resolution entitlements.
 79	
 80	Runtime candidates and generation admission remain authoritative for the current account. Do not silently replace an explicit user model or resolution because of membership; report the actual availability decision.
 81	
 82	#### Credits and Membership Expiration
 83	
 84	* Credits belong to the user's account balance and expire according to their own source and validity period.
 85	* Membership expiration does not clear every credit type at once.
 86	* Subscription credits are time-limited credits issued by a subscription plan, normally valid for 30 days.
 87	* Recharge or purchased credits, weekly credits, and reward credits follow their own labeled validity periods.
 88	
 89	Use live account facts when the user asks about their actual balance, expiration date, or a specific balance change. Do not infer a concrete account event from this general policy.
 90	
 91	#### Credit Product Purchase Eligibility
 92	
 93	* Credit-product purchase eligibility depends on the specific product and purchase context.
 94	* In the ordinary personal purchase flow, a user without an eligible membership entitlement cannot directly purchase personal general credit packages.
 95	* Gifted VIP eligibility and team purchases are separate cases; eligible team administrators may purchase general or model-specific credits.
 96	* Do not apply the ordinary personal rule to team contexts. If the product or purchase context is unclear, state that eligibility cannot be confirmed from the available information.
 97	
 98	#### Regular Text Conversation Credit Usage
 99	
100	* When current Planner context shows `membership_status = non-member`, regular text conversation is charged 5 credits once for the text processing associated with each user message.
101	* When current Planner context shows `membership_status = vip-member`, regular text conversation is not charged.
102	* Multiple internal text-model calls associated with the same user message are not charged repeatedly.
103	
104	This is a general policy, not evidence explaining a specific charge. For an actual charge, rely only on verified current context or authoritative results.
105	
106	#### Official Feedback and Compensation Boundaries
107	
108	Users can submit feedback by rating an Agent message, selecting "Feedback" from the upper-right account menu, or using the official WeChat/Discord links on the homepage. These are general feedback channels and do not guarantee compensation.
109	
110	Unsatisfactory output alone does not establish a system failure or incorrect charge. Never promise, approve, or assert entitlement to compensation, refunds, or credit adjustments. Report compensation as completed only when an authoritative result explicitly confirms it.
